description: This file contains serialization codec implementations for primitive integer types in the Orleans framework, including classes like BoolCodec, CharCodec, ByteCodec, SByteCodec, UInt16Codec, Int16Codec, UInt32Codec, Int32Codec, Int64Codec, UInt64Codec, and optionally Int128Codec and UInt128Codec for NET7.0+, with methods for reading and writing these types to a wire protocol.

classes.name: BoolCodec
classes.description: Serializer for boolean values, implementing IFieldCodec<bool> with methods for reading and writing boolean values in wire protocol.

classes.name: CharCodec
classes.description: Serializer for char values, implementing IFieldCodec<char> with methods for reading and writing characters.

classes.name: ByteCodec
classes.description: Serializer for byte values, implementing IFieldCodec<byte>.

classes.name: SByteCodec
classes.description: Serializer for sbyte values, implementing IFieldCodec<sbyte>.

classes.name: UInt16Codec
classes.description: Serializer for ushort values, implementing IFieldCodec<ushort>.

classes.name: Int16Codec
classes.description: Serializer for short values, implementing IFieldCodec<short>.

classes.name: UInt32Codec
classes.description: Serializer for uint values, implementing IFieldCodec<uint>.

classes.name: Int32Codec
classes.description: Serializer for int values, implementing IFieldCodec<int>.

classes.name: Int64Codec
classes.description: Serializer for long values, implementing IFieldCodec<long>.

classes.name: UInt64Codec
classes.description: Serializer for ulong values, implementing IFieldCodec<ulong>.

classes.name: Int128Codec
classes.description: Serializer for Int128 values, optional for NET7.0+, implementing IFieldCodec<Int128> with methods for reading and writing extended integer values.

classes.name: UInt128Codec
classes.description: Serializer for UInt128 values, optional for NET7.0+, implementing IFieldCodec<UInt128>.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Methods for writing values for each type, with variations for expected types and actual types, and aggressive inlining.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Methods for reading values, typically static, with aggressive inlining.
